ingestion_method: byte-for-byte export of the certified release candidate; no recomputation, no rounding, no schema change

excluded.catchers: MLB SDR contains no catcher rows at all -- the model's MLB scope is 1B, 2B, 3B, SS, LF, CF, RF. Final catcher SDR is not certified.
excluded.2026 pitcher eWAR: 0 rows; the substrate ends at 2025 and is not manufactured

important.mlb_position_player_ewar_fielding_compon: Defense+, NOT SDR. Refreshing MLB SDR does not make MLB eWAR fielding current by that route. Its 2026 rows carry ~108 team games against a league median of 127 at 2026-08-19.
important.forward_calibration: Calibration estimated on the certified historical window is frozen for forward scoring; adding a season does not restate prior ones.

files.freshness_note: limited by its own offence substrate
